title: “What if the very thing you’re ashamed of is the doorway God plans to use for your destiny?
paragraphs:
“What if the very thing you’re ashamed of is the doorway God plans to use for your destiny?
Give Him your weakness — watch Him turn it into strength, purpose, and glory.”

2 Corinthians 12:9 (NIV)
“But He said to me, ‘My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.’”
So I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.
